description: This Java class 'ImageData' represents metadata for image files in a document management system. It encapsulates properties such as location, storage type, entity display name, and content type derived from the file extension.

classes.name: ImageData
classes.description: A data class that encapsulates image metadata such as location, storage type, display name, and MIME type.

methods.name: ImageData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes ImageData with location, storage type, entity display name, and derives content type based on file extension.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: storageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type of the image.

methods.name: location
methods.description: Returns the location (path or URL) of the image.

methods.name: getEntityDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the entity associated with the image.
